_comment: Windows. npx is a .cmd shim that many MCP clients cannot spawn directly, so it is run through `cmd /c` — the standard fix. Node.js must be installed first (the official .msi puts npx on PATH, and cmd /c finds it). ego is NOT an MCP server and is not listed here: on Windows it is in beta and is driven through the ego-browser skill. Cua Driver's path differs per machine: run `cua-driver mcp-config` after installing it and use the exact output it prints instead of the placeholder below.
